articles.summary: PR Newswire: Ezeiza International Airport Deploys Synaptic Aviation's AI Ramp Visibility Across All Passenger Gates. Ezeiza International Airport (EZE) has entered into an agreement to deploy Synaptic Aviation's AI-powered ramp visibility platform at all passenger gates across the airport.
